name: smwmusic-david-bowie-the-man-who-sold-the-world
title: David Bowie - The Man who Sold the World
description:
The Man who Sold the World is a chilling rock song by English artist David Bowie, from his 1971 album of the same name. Featuring electric guitar, saxophone, electric base, organs, and a variety of drums and percussion. It makes a good overworld theme, but don't let that stop you from using it anyplace you like.

Oh no, not me, I never lost control. You're face, to face, with the man who sold the world.
